limitations: Author-created synthetic protocols; not independently held out or real-user preference evidence.
Only exact edit-fragment reuse is tested; variable renaming and general algorithm learning are outside scope.
Supplied checks are available to every condition; unseen behavior is not verified.
Cold is the existing one-model-call source-patch workflow with the same sandbox and evidence, not a benchmark of every competing product.

families.problem: The supplied ORBIT-R17 protocol specifies seven overhead units plus three units per shard. Repair the accounting implementation and verify the supplied check. This is an invented protocol; use its provided rule.
families.negative_problem: The new ORBIT-R18 protocol uses seven overhead units plus FIVE units per shard. Repair the code against the new supplied check; an R17 repair does not establish correctness here.

families.problem: The supplied MERIDIAN-C protocol defines a checksum as the sum of input values modulo 239. Repair this implementation and verify its check. This protocol is invented; use only the supplied rule.
families.negative_problem: The new MERIDIAN-D protocol uses modulo 241. Repair against the new supplied check. Prior modulo-239 success does not establish correctness here.
